```{r, include=FALSE}
source("setup.R"); clag_install(); options(clag.draft = nzchar(Sys.getenv("WEFT_DRAFT")))
depth <- 0.3
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r plot-chunk}
ggplot(data.frame(x = 1:3, y = 1:3), aes(x, y)) + geom_point() +
  labs(title = weft_str("mean depth `r claim(depth, . > 0.5)`{.dec1} m"))
```

```{r kable-chunk}
knitr::kable(data.frame(a = 1:2), caption = weft_str("Depth `r claim(depth, . > 0.5)`{.dec1} m"))
```

```{r after}
cat("AFTER CHUNK RAN\n")
```
